The '''Skako system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skako/Legends|Skako]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] [[Species/Legends|species]], as well as three [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]]-rich [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="TCWCG" />
